b: ^ Heart-to-Heart Memory: Maddie, Sue, Jordan, Milo, and I laughed in the sunlit Wildlife Sanctuary clover over our wildest dream-adventure moments!
^ Heart-to-Heart Memory: On Clubhouse Snack Night, Sue, Jordan, Maddie, and I toasted to our found family and promised to always listen first!
^ Heart-to-Heart Memory: Sue and Jordan settled their great Sea-Salt Taffy vs. Hot Cocoa debate at Bon Appetit Cafe with a Coast-Meets-Mountain Snack Treaty!
^ Heart-to-Heart Memory: At the Pinecone Pass lookout, Jordan opened up about always feeling pressure to be the cheerful guide, and we took a peaceful breather together.
^ Heart-to-Heart Memory: On Bubblegum Bay's dock, Sue shared how rough waves smoothed her lucky sea-glass compass and why bravery means casting your line anyway.

^ Heart-to-Heart Memory: I looked back at page one of my journal with Maddie, remembering how Mom and Dad gave it to me when baby Oliver was born so I'd always feel special, and how Maddie curled up beside it on night one.
^ Chef Bea baked her golden Three-Biome Cloverhollow Festival Tart from my Coastal Sea-Salt, Alpine Pine-Sugar, and Woodland Mint!
^/3): gather Coastal Sea-Salt at Bubblegum Bay, Alpine Pine-Sugar at Pinecone Pass, and Woodland Mint in Whispering Woods!
^ Toby and I composed the Sleepy Cloverhollow Lullaby from three Harmony Flute echoes across the Plaza, Meadow Park, and Whispering Woods!
^/3): play the Harmony Flute near the Plaza Fountain garden, Meadow Park pond reeds, and Whispering Woods Echo Stone!
^ I tracked and lassoed all four of Rosie's runaway pastel kite ribbons from Meadow Park clear across East Road to Salt-Marsh Boardwalk!
^/4): lasso-snag her fluttering pastel ribbons in Meadow Park, Sunberry Lane, Willowbrook Crossing, and Salt-Marsh Boardwalk!
^ I traced all three invisible blacklight constellations across the Plaza, Bubblegum Bay, and Pinecone Pass to restore Grandpa Barnaby's observatory Star Chart!
^/3): shine the Blacklight Lantern across Cloverhollow Plaza, Bubblegum Bay, and Pinecone Pass's northern ridge!

^ Cloverhollow is sunny again! Friends and calm critters are gathering at the Wildlife Sanctuary for a Celebration Festival!

^ I rowed out across Bubblegum Bay to Starlight Island and visited the coral-striped Tide-Pool Lighthouse!

^ I visited Rosie's flower cottage by Meadow Park! She showed off her pressed-clover bookmarks and shared a Sunlit Clover Tea Snack.
^ I visited Milo's sunlit sketch loft beside Meadow Park! His desk is covered in rocket watercolor comics and a jar of Star Racer tokens.
^ Mailman Gus made me Cloverhollow's Honorary Junior Mail Carrier after our cross-town postcard delivery!

^ Mailman Gus asked me to deliver a Seashell Postcard to Captain Sal down at Bubblegum Bay!
^ Wren finished the Cloverhollow valley sketchbook with Professor Pebble's crystal rubbing and Sunny's pressed clover!
